snippet.title: lunr.rdio.taxi/demo // teaser /EN
snippet.description:
Drift through psychedelic interplanetary roads while you make your ship dance at irresponsible speeds to the sound of the hottest DJs of the current brazilian underground club scene in lunr.rdio.taxi – a mix of Drifting and Rhythm that we like to call Drifthm.

You don't have to wait too long now, the first chapter of the game, lunr.rdio.taxi/demo, is scheduled to be released on Steam and Itch on Q1 2026!

lunr.rdio.taxi is being developed by Soín in partnership with Speedtest Rave
